title: Single open-square restricted counit identity
statement: For a scheme morphism gprime:Xprime→X, K in D(X), and opens W⊆U with inclusion k, put j:U→X and l:W→X. Put p_U,q_U,p_W,q_W for the pullback projections, r for relativeMVOpenLift, c:Lk∘Lj≅Ll, cprime:Lr∘Lp_U≅Lp_W, and gamma_N:Lq_W Ll N→Lp_W Lgprime N the canonical square comparison. Let theta:Lq_U Lj K→Lp_U Lgprime K be the analogous U comparison. For C=Rj Lj K, gamma_C followed by Lp_W of (base change for j followed by Rp_U(theta)), followed by cprime inverse, Lr of the p_U counit, and cprime at Lgprime K, equals Lq_W of (c inverse at C, Lk of the j-counit, c at K), followed by gamma_K. Every comparison is the fixed comparison of def-pc-relative-mv-maps. No map to a base scheme is involved.

proof.text: The private restriction_square lemma proves the abstract counit identity from coefficient coherence and the base-change transpose. Move Tprime.map(a) through the inverse target restriction comparison by naturality. Coefficient coherence at C identifies gamma_C followed by that inverse comparison with LqW(c inverse) followed by d and Lr(theta_C).

The private baseChange_counit lemma unfolds schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap as the pinned adjunction transpose and uses Equiv.symm_apply_apply. Hom-equivalence naturality moves the target coefficient map through this transpose. At C, the forward coefficient comparison cancels its inverse; the two equality transports cancel by proof irrelevance and eqToHom_trans. Thus theta_C followed by LpU(a) and the pU counit equals LqU of the U counit followed by theta_K.

Substitute that transpose identity in the abstract calculation, apply naturality of d to the U counit, and use coefficient coherence at K. Functor.map_comp and associativity give exactly the original displayed equality. Only the pure coefficient-coherence step is postponed.

theorem relativeMV_open_square_counit
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (W U : X.Opens) (i : W ≤ U) :
    let C := (schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)
    let c := relativeMVComp (X.homOfLE i) U.ι ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun t : W.toScheme ⟶ X ↦ derivedPullback t)
        (Scheme.homOfLE_ι X i))
    let c' := relativeMVComp (relativeMVOpenLift g' i) (pullback.fst g' U.ι) ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun t : pullback g' W.ι ⟶ X' ↦ derivedPullback t)
        (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _))
    let γ (N : schemeDerivedCategory X) :=
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' W.ι) W.ι).hom.app N ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj N)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := W.ι)).symm) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' W.ι) g').inv.app N
    let θ := (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' U.ι) U.ι).hom.app K ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := U.ι)).symm) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' U.ι) g').inv.app K
    γ C ≫ (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι)).map
        (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap U.ι (pullback.fst g' U.ι) g'
            (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := U.ι)).symm
            ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K) ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).map θ) ≫
      c'.inv.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj ((derivedPullback g').obj K))) ≫
      (derivedPullback (relativeMVOpenLift g' i)).map
        ((relativeMVAdj (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).counit.app
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj ((derivedPullback g').obj K))) ≫
      c'.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj K) =
      (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' W.ι)).map
        (c.inv.app C ≫ (derivedPullback (X.homOfLE i)).map
          ((relativeMVAdj U.ι).counit.app ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)) ≫ c.hom.app K) ≫
      γ K
